assumptions: The sky owner's global ambient/fill and haze change lands in the same frames, so every colour target on a hazed mid-ground surface is contaminated and only the direction of the move is this owner's to predict.
The bamboo card texture is 512x1024 at MEDIUM (measured by readback), i.e. cells are 256x512.
unresolvedQuestions: Finding 2's target (dash box 51,94,405x117 must reach luma p1 >= 190 and detail <= 1.2) is unreachable: with the entire bamboo card mesh hidden the same box still measures p1 88.3 / detail 2.15, because it contains near bamboo geometry at its left edge and sakura at its lower right. The achievable floor is the cards-off control, and the reachable criterion is detail <= 2.8 with no dash population visible at native resolution.

Finding 3's target (d), a visible trunk under the sakura in phone-wide, is not a Foliage defect: the crop (900,520,340x200) shows the tree's base occluded by the honden roof and the vermilion torii. The impostor bake does include the trunk — frameRel puts the card's lower edge at 0.023 of tree height — so the trunk draws wherever a sakura is not behind architecture. Re-siting that tree is Level.js's call, not this file's.

Finding 1's target (a) asks the valley box to invert to G > R by >= 12. The illuminant caps this: GREEN_RATIO's key is (1.0, 0.412, 0.134), so only an albedo above g/r 2.43 can be green-dominant when lit, and the pale culm that makes the band read as bamboo cannot be that green. This round moves the ratio with leaf area and with the transmission path; whether it crosses zero depends on the sky owner's haze.

The fern atlas (paintFernAtlas, atlas [2,2] at line ~4534) has the same 2x2 horizontal seam the bamboo card just lost, and its cells also carry content at the cell's bottom edge (the frond base is drawn at translate(..., half)). It was NOT changed: undergrowth is read at 0-30 m where the sampled mip is near level 0, so the bleed is a one-texel stem rather than the 86.7%-opaque skirt row measured on the bamboo sheet, and nothing in review-r15 measures it. Check it before assuming it is clean.

risks: The denser bamboo crown could over-close the card and lose the pale-culm cue that says bamboo rather than shrub; two front culms are re-stroked with an alpha ramp to keep stems crossing the mass.
uWarmFill lifts the shadowed sakura by roughly +20 luma on the away-facing clusters, which flattens the crown's modelling if the sky owner also raises fill.

The impostor chroma pull at 0.72 also desaturates cedar and momiji impostors; that is a deliberate global mute of the distant grove and could read as washed out if the postfx owner also lowers contrast.
Boot cost: paintBambooClump now runs two spray passes over more attachment bands, roughly 3.4x the canvas path operations for that sheet.
